result.summary: The page is generally well laid out, but there is a noticeable vertical misalignment in the 'Fastest near you' carousel where the middle card is offset compared to its neighbors, creating an uneven, visually broken row.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the middle card (Smash Bros Burgers) is vertically offset: its image starts lower than the Green Bowl Poké and Trattoria Piccola cards, so the image tops, titles, and delivery-fee lines do not align across the row.
issues.suggestion: Align all carousel cards to a common top edge and use a fixed image height so titles and metadata sit on the same baseline across every card.

issues.description: The card images in the 'Fastest near you' row appear to have slightly different heights/aspect ratios (the burger image is taller than the poké image), which contributes to the ragged look of the row.
issues.suggestion: Enforce a consistent aspect ratio (e.g., via object-fit: cover on a fixed-height container) for all thumbnails in the carousel.

issues.description: The delivery-time pill placement is inconsistent between cards: on the first card it sits near the bottom-left of the image, while on the middle card it sits lower relative to the image, reinforcing the misaligned appearance.
issues.suggestion: Anchor the time pill to the same position (e.g., fixed inset from the image's bottom-left corner) on every card.
